item.title: [WFLA News Channel 8] Trump signs order renaming Lake Ontario as 'Lake America' in the United States
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — President Donald Trump said Thursday he is renaming Lake Ontario to be known as “Lake America” in the United States as he escalates his trade war with Canada. The Republican president signed an executive order directing the Interior Department to update the lake's name in the U.S. geographic naming service. Trump cannot [...]

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] President Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario amid trade war with Canada
item.description: President Trump signed an order to rename Lake Ontario to Lake America one week after he increased tariffs on Canadian imports.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Three teens, one 13, now charged as adults in Tampa attempted murder: SAO
item.description: Three teenagers, one aged 13, are now being charged as adults in the Tampa attempted murder of a homeless man in July.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Military judge sets June 2028 trial date for alleged Sept. 11 mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed
item.description: A military judge has set a June 5, 2028, trial date for Khalid Sheikh Mohammed and three others accused of plotting the Sept. 11 attacks.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] More than 3 million grill brushes have been recalled due to an ingestion hazard
item.description: Conair has expanded a recall of Cuisinart grill brushes due to an ingestion hazard. More than 3.6 million brushes have since been recalled.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: hurricane, tropical storm] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tropical Storm Dolly forms in the Atlantic Ocean with 40 mph winds
item.description: Tropical Storm Dolly, the fourth named storm of the Atlantic hurricane season, formed Thursday morning in the central Atlantic Ocean.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Authorities sound alarm for Honda owners over a spike in air bag thefts
item.description: Authorities across the country are sounding the alarm for Honda owners over a spike in air bag thefts.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Jury now deliberating Lindsay Clancy’s fate in deaths of her 3 children
item.description: A jury is now deliberating in the Lindsay Clancy trial. She's accused of killing her 3 children and has pleaded not guilty. What verdict do you expect?

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man dies after steel beam falls on him in Pinellas County
item.description: A man died after a steel beam fell on him Thursday morning in Pinellas County. Authorities say firefighters took him to a hospital after removing the beam.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] CDC confirms more than 17,000 cyclosporiasis cases across US
item.description: The CDC confirmed more than 1,000 new cyclosporiasis cases this summer, bringing the national total to more than 17,000.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Republican nominee for Maine governor says he wants ICE agents at polling places in the state
item.description: Maine's Republican nominee for governor says he wants ICE agents and U.S. Marshals at polling places this fall. State officials say that's illegal. Here's what we know.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Partial lunar eclipse will turn most of the moon blood red
item.description: About 93% of the moon will be eclipsed during this week’s lunar event, giving much of it a deep red appearance at peak eclipse.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Interactive: Retailers are getting billions in tariff refunds. Will any of It reach you?
item.description: The Supreme Court struck down sweeping federal tariffs — and now $166 billion is flowing back to businesses. But whether that money finds its way to your wallet depends entirely on where you shop.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: tropical storm] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tropical Storm Dolly arrives shortly after death of Dolly Parton
item.description: Tropical Storm Dolly formed in the Atlantic on Thursday, reviving a storm name that coincidentally resurfaced days after Dolly Parton’s death.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former Pasco deputy indicted for sexual battery of a minor: HCSO
item.description: A former Pasco County deputy has been indicted for sexual battery on a person under 12-years-old in Hernando County, officials said.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ICE agent accused of shooting man during Minneapolis crackdown released in Texas
item.description: An ICE officer charged in a Minneapolis shooting and accused of lying about it was released from a Texas jail as Minnesota’s extradition fight continues.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] President Trump heads to Texas to boost Ken Paxton ahead of midterm elections
item.description: Trump is heading to Texas to fundraise for Senate candidate Ken Paxton as new polling shows Democrat James Talarico in the lead.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Idaho judge warns Kohberger attorneys over evidence rules in plea fight
item.description: An Idaho judge set a timeline for Bryan Kohberger’s effort to withdraw his guilty plea in the killings of four University of Idaho students.

item.title: [WATCHLIST: city council] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Tampa City Council set to vote on $2 billion Rays stadium plan
item.description: Tampa city leaders are voting on the final version of a stadium plan that has been in the works for months, with the Rays' future in Tampa Bay hanging in the balance.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Kentucky officer accused of using police cameras to track ex over 2,000 times
item.description: A Kentucky officer was arrested after allegedly using police license plate reader cameras more than 2,000 times to track his ex-girlfriend.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Puerto Rican kikiriki chickens winning hearts across Florida
item.description: Puerto Rican kikiriki chickens are becoming one of Florida's fastest-growing pet trends. A Tampa Bay breeder says demand for the miniature birds has exploded as more people discover their calm, affectionate personalities.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Nepal flash flood leaves 1,300 missing, including 65 Americans
item.description: Scientists say a glacier collapse likely triggered Nepal’s deadly flash flood, leaving 1,300 missing — including 65 Americans.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Retailers are getting billions in tariff refunds. Will you see any of it?
item.description: Walmart got $2.9B in tariff refunds. Here's which retailers are passing savings to shoppers — and which aren't

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Man who served 40 years for murder, gets life for human trafficking: SAO
item.description: A man who had already served 40 years in prison for murder was sentenced to life on Wednesday for human trafficking of a minor, prosecutors said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Video: Education Secretary McMahon speaks in exclusive one-on-one interview
item.description: McMahon visited John Adams Academy in Sterling Ranch as the Trump administration pushes to return education control to the states.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Pasco County sheriff issues warning as license plate reader cameras program to end: 'disappointing'
item.description: Pasco County Sheriff Chris Nocco said he is ending an agreement that allows license plate detection systems along county rights-of-way, as Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis separately calls for tighter restrictions on the rapidly expanding technology.
